title: Rhode Island Town Population Estimates 2024
description: The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing U.S. Census Bureau project that releases yearly data on American life. It offers both 1-year and 5-year reports, with the 5-year version aggregating larger amounts of data for more accurate estimates. The data on this map comes directly from the 2024 5-year ACS.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau. (2024). 2020–2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates. Retrieved from https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs
